propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but have no repair-specific logic and are imported by seven production modules, creating an inverted dependency where store-layer code imports from command-layer repair module.

Moving the three primitives from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py (a stdlib-only leaf module) will eliminate the inverted dependency while preserving gitutil's acyclic import graph, since all consumers are _commands modules already importing _store.

Compatibility surfaces must be preserved: fsck.py re-exports must continue resolving, and fsck_repair module attributes must remain bindable for test monkeypatching in test_repair_pause_ownership.py, test_repair_pause_ownership_heldout.py, and test_scan_scoping.py.
The move is behavior-preserving with function bodies moved verbatim and no test file edits required; gitutil stays under 800 LOC and no circular imports are introduced.
